modeReason: Amazon's million-robot workforce milestone (novelty 2 × magnitude 3 × breadth 3 = 18) clears the relevance threshold of 8 on its own, so today stands as its own story rather than continuing yesterday's persistence/art-premium theme.
phrase: A major retailer now runs over a million robot workers alongside its human staff. Meanwhile, a tech executive warned that AI still has fewer rules than milk.
phraseAlternatives: One company now runs more robot workers than most nations have soldiers. A tech executive says AI still has fewer rules than milk.
A warehouse giant crossed a million robot workers this week. A tech executive says milk cartons carry more warning labels than AI does.
More than a million robots now work for one retailer. The same week, a tech leader said milk is better regulated than AI.
A retailer's robot workforce just passed a million. An executive pointed out that milk has more rules than artificial intelligence.

brief.concept: A warehouse packed with a long line of identical robot workers dwarfs one small human worker, while beside it a milk carton wears more safety labels than the single robot standing next to it.
brief.metaphor: Machines now outnumber people on the job, yet carry fewer safety rules than the milk in a refrigerator.

cast.who: a long row of identical robot workers stacking boxes in a warehouse
a single human worker standing small at the end of the row
a milk carton covered in small safety labels and stamps
a robot standing beside the carton wearing only one blank label

brief.composition: Split scene, thin dividing line down the middle. Left: a warehouse aisle in one-point perspective with a repeating row of small identical robot shapes holding boxes shrinking to a vanishing point; one human figure stands alone at the near edge, clearly smaller than the robot line implies. Right: a tall milk carton covered in several small rectangular labels, next to a single robot shape wearing one plain blank label. Flat pale blueprint-blue fills, white outlines, one yellow highlight on the blank label.
brief.alt: A warehouse scene shows a long line of identical robot workers stacking boxes, dwarfing one small human worker at the end. Beside it, a milk carton covered in safety labels stands next to a single robot wearing only one blank label.
